design: All frozen10 H852 fits and78H849 pairs. Diagnostic coefficient oracles, no training. Pairwise contrast projected into full512 decoder span, covered-membership span, or union of native donor/recipient active atoms. Also independent per-state least-squares reconstruction on each frozen native support, retaining decoder bias.
fairness: Full dictionary rank up to512, active-union up to128, per-state support48/64/variable. These are capacity diagnostics, not equal-cost architecture rankings. Covered span excludes inaccessible untrained atoms in learnedshared. Independent per-state LS uses only input/known decoder/support, not task contrast or label; gates remain frozen.
intervention: Same H853 native normalizedshape + predicted donor-minus-recipient contrast; normalize/restore recipientradius. Exactshape and identity controls. No effect-based filtering.
numerics: Float64 SVD numerical rank threshold1e-10 times largest singularvalue. Audit projection orthogonality, nesting/reconstruction errors, per-state LS <= learned reconstruction error. Record effective ranks/condition numbers.
scope: Reused task panel. Oracles diagnose representability, not learned semantic units. Same-token means cancel but encoding/support may be out-of-distribution.
